title: When Saying No Makes Better Videos: Designing Dual Gatekeeping for Pedagogically Grounded AI Content Creation
abstract: arXiv:2608.19812v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: To prevent the adoption of aesthetically polished but pedagogically flawed AI content, we study a video authoring pipeline featuring two layers of structured refusal. The first layer empowers educators to iteratively reshape AI scripts based on multimedia learning theory, while the second employs automated metrics to flag violations in instructional coherence and narrative-visual synchronization. While neither layer is exhaustive, their synergy ensures that principled resistance--the act of deferring AI output until it meets rigorous standards--becomes a catalyst for higher quality. Evaluation combining a study with 23 educators across 3 topics and automated metrics across 7 topics drawn from established science and philosophy curricula shows that both layers independently improve the same instructional dimensions, suggesting that thoughtful resistance and generative AI are not opposites but partners.

translated_title: 当拒绝造就更好的视频：为基于教学法的AI内容创作设计双重把关机制
translated_abstract: 摘要：为防止采用外观精美但教学法上有缺陷的AI生成内容，我们研究了一种包含两层结构化拒绝的视频创作流程。第一层赋予教育工作者基于多媒体学习理论迭代重塑AI脚本的能力，而第二层则采用自动指标来标记教学连贯性和叙事-视觉同步方面的违规行为。虽然每一层都不是万能的，但它们的协同作用确保了有原则的抵制——即延迟接受AI输出直至其达到严格标准的做法——成为提升质量的催化剂。评估结合了针对3个主题的23名教育工作者的研究和针对7个主题（选自既有科学和哲学课程）的自动指标，结果表明两层独立地改善了相同的教学维度，这表明深思熟虑的抵制与生成式AI并非对立面，而是合作伙伴。
tldr: 本文提出一种双重把关机制，通过教育工作者迭代重塑和自动指标审查，使对AI输出的有原则拒绝成为提升教学视频质量的关键，证明抵制与生成式AI是互补的合作伙伴。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dual gatekeeping mechanism where principled refusal of AI output, through educator iteration and automated metrics, serves as a catalyst for higher-quality pedagogical videos, showing that resistance and generative AI are complementary partners.
